name: Service catalogue to a prefilled enquiry
description: Browse the catalogue and open a service-specific enquiry.
steps: Open Services from the main navigation.
Open Gypsum Partitions & Drywall and review its scope and FAQ.
expected: The Contact Us form has Gypsum Partitions & Drywall selected, and clearly states delivery is not connected.

name: Validation and honest delivery failure
description: Invalid input is rejected and valid input cannot claim delivery without configuration.
steps: Open Contact Us and submit the empty form.

Verify validation errors, then fill Name with Test Customer, Phone with +971501234567, Project location with Test location, service Gypsum False Ceilings, and description Plan a ceiling for my living room.
Expand Add photos, dimensions or other details and verify uploads are unavailable.
expected: The page reports that nothing has been sent because delivery is not configured, retains the entered name and description, and never shows a success confirmation.

name: Mobile navigation and inspiration selection
description: Select inspiration on a phone and confirm unavailable contact actions are honest.
steps: Open the mobile menu and choose Projects.
Scroll to the inspiration collection and choose Minimal flat ceilings.
Check that the enquiry description includes Minimal flat ceilings.
Tap WhatsApp in the bottom bar, dismiss its notice, and open then close the mobile menu.
expected: The style is preserved in the form. WhatsApp shows a configuration notice without sending a message. The menu can be closed and the page has no horizontal overflow.

name: Verified content boundaries and accessible information
description: Review information pages without fabricated credentials or projects.
steps: Open Projects and verify the portfolio empty state and labelled inspiration images.
Open About Us and review the pending company confirmation notice.
Open Privacy Policy in the footer.
Return Home and use keyboard navigation to expand What do you need for a quotation?.
expected: No fictional project, rating or credential is published. Privacy information and the expanded FAQ answer are readable, with visible keyboard focus.

name: All service content and mobile contact controls
description: Check unique service details and mobile contact safety.
steps: Open Services and visit each of the six service cards, returning to Services between visits.
On Acoustic & Fire-Rated Systems expand Is a fire-rated board enough? and read its answer.
On Gypsum Repairs & Finishing review the leak and moisture warnings.
Tap Call in the bottom bar.
expected: All six service pages render their own content. The acoustic answer explains assembly-level performance. Call shows an unconfigured phone notice instead of a fake telephone link.
